record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The seven units in appliesTo declare AQUA_JET: Arrokuda, Buizel, Remoraid, Surskit, Wishiwashi (1 star), Floatzel (2 stars) and Suicune (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), range and maxPP. Wishiwashi's passive WISHIWASHI is not covered. Surskit has range 2; the cast does not use range.
record.summary: The caster dashes to the cell chosen by Board.getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace (a free cell next to an enemy that was strictly farther than earlier candidates; same helper as NUZZLE) and deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by stars) to every enemy on the straight line of cells between its starting cell and that destination. If no enemy is on the line, or the helper returns null, the cast target is hit instead (and the caster does not move when null).

targeting.who: enemies in the cells of the supercover line from the caster's current position to the destination chosen by the helper; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: The line is computed before the move, so the destination cell (free) and the caster's own cell hold no enemy. The destination is next to the helper's selected enemy, not on it, so that enemy is hit only if the line crosses its cell. The helper's quirks recorded for NUZZLE apply: a nearer retained selection when a farther enemy has no free adjacent cell, and a closest-free-cell fallback. The cast target is hit by the fallback only when no enemy at all is on the line.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the destination cell, both ends included; every touched cell counts, including diagonal-corner crossings

effects.target: each enemy on the line (each once); else the cast target
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); no falloff along the line
effects.resolution: then each target's SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce per target

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3 for the listed units); the 4-star column (160) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Needs at least one targettable enemy for the helper to return a cell; otherwise the caster stays and the cast target is hit. Which enemies are on the line depends on the caster's and the destination's coordinates; a destination equal to the caster's own cell is not distinguished in the code read.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast recomputes the destination and the line on the current board; moveTo sets the caster's cooldown to 100 for faster retargeting.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 20/40/80 (1/2/3 stars) per enemy hit. The damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers, per target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Board scan order (board.forEach), the distanceM metric and isTargettableBy semantics were not read
Whether the dash is instant or animated and whether units on the line are displaced (swapCells was located, not read)
unresolved: Wishiwashi's passive WISHIWASHI is not investigated
Which enemy wins a distance tie and the exact meaning of 'farthest' (distanceM, board scan order not read)
Whether the line from caster to destination can pass through allied units and whether they are affected (they are ignored by the filter)
Whether moveTo / swapCells has side effects on the other cell's occupant beyond what was read (the destination is free by construction)
Whether the eight-neighbour retained-selection quirk is common in real boards
Whether the seven units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
